patch.rationale: Analyst uses 9-10 calls checking every record tool for one returned-count question and hits tool-call limit. trip_history already returns counts by outcome in one town+date call, so using it once and stopping fixes fan-out.

patch.text: For custom breakdowns no other tool groups by (e.g. by weekday): call describe_tables once, then use ONE run_query SELECT to answer; do not try other tools first.
patch.rationale: Cuts wasted steps that cause step-limit failures on custom analytics by going straight to one describe+one query and avoids repeat describe_tables calls.
